list: The official 55 trophies, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles before this bounty opened (2026-11-18). Names, descriptions and grades are PlayStation's own; guides are this entry's own words.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Treat it as the finish line, not a task: follow the roadmap stages in order and it arrives on its own. Expect a long road; early guide estimates put the platinum at roughly 200 hours.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play through the opening mission Gone Fishing to the end and this unlocks automatically. It is a story trophy, so it cannot be earned out of order — just keep playing. Flagged missable only because the game has no mission replay: keep a manual save before story missions, as trophy guides recommend, so a failed run can be retried from the save rather than a new game.

sources.name: U7BUY — GTA 6 trophies guide (no mission replay)

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1 and the trophy unlocks at the chapter's end. Before leaving Chapter 1, do the meditation event at Jason's house: guides flag it as potentially missable and it feeds the Positive Mental Attitude trophy. Keep a manual save at the chapter boundary, since there is no mission replay.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2 and the trophy unlocks at the chapter's end. There is no optional step — completing the chapter is the whole requirement. Keep a manual save before the chapter's final mission, since the game offers no mission replay.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3 and the trophy unlocks at the chapter's end. Chapter 3 is where Vice City itself opens up, so use the lull between its missions to start the open-world checklists (vehicles, areas, WAiNK scans) that the later stages need. Keep a manual save before the chapter's final mission.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4 and the trophy unlocks at the chapter's end. By now the character questlines (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) should be underway — their final missions carry their own trophies, so do not leave them all for after the story. Keep a manual save before the chapter's final mission.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission and this gold trophy unlocks. It is the last story beat, so before starting it, finish any story-gated side content you still want: character questlines and stranger strands stay available after the story, but a manual save here costs nothing and protects the one-playthrough run. After the credits, the 100% checklist opens in the Progress menu.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Play the mission Breakfast Run through to its end. It unlocks automatically on completion — there is no extra objective inside the mission. Keep a manual save before starting it, since the game has no mission replay.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Play the mission The Cartel Heist through to its end. It is one of the big set-piece heists; completing the mission is the whole requirement, with no side objective to chase inside it. Keep a manual save before starting it, since the game has no mission replay.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Child's Play through to its end. Completing the mission is the whole requirement. Keep a manual save before starting it, since the game has no mission replay.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Play the mission Headliners through to its end. Completing the mission is the whole requirement. Keep a manual save before starting it, since the game has no mission replay.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Play the mission VCIA Takedown through to its end — the airport takedown at Vice City International. Completing the mission is the whole requirement. Keep a manual save before starting it, since the game has no mission replay.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Play the mission Operation Savage Glory through to its end. Completing the mission is the whole requirement. Keep a manual save before starting it, since the game has no mission replay.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist, which opens in the Progress menu after the story. The checklist counts story progress, criminal activities, exploration and collectibles — but only part of several categories, so 100% does not mean collecting literally everything. Work through it last: most of its items overlap with other trophies (42 shooting-range golds, 70 of 80 challenges, 100 optional tasks, 200 base-model vehicles scanned, 100 animal species studied), so tick them off together and let this gold land as the cleanup finishes.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near misses, long air time and other driving feats the game counts as stunts. Do not grind it in one sitting: stunts rack up naturally while driving between missions, so fold it into normal play and only farm the last few dozen deliberately, chaining jumps off ramps and hills. The in-game counter is the source of truth; use the tracker's counter here to log your own tally.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the game's 9 activity types at least once — the count comes from the official description via PSNProfiles. Work through the list early, one of each: a race, fishing, an arcade game, bowling, a drone race, a shooting-range challenge, meditation, hunting and a stunt event will cover most of them. Anything you already did for other trophies counts, so check the tracker before repeating an activity.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges — the count is PSN's, confirmed by both trackers. This is one of the three biggest grinds in the list, so spread it out: learn one weapon class at a time, use the range's own scoring feedback, and leave the hardest challenges for when your aim and weapon handling are upgraded. Gold every challenge; silver or bronze medals do not count.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location is its own race, so you must win at every one — a win at one place never covers another. Learn each course's tight corners before racing flat out, and tick locations off in the tracker as you win them so none is left behind.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — the word different matters, so the same race won twice counts once. Spread across race types and locations, and pair this with the drone races and stunt work so the driving practice pays twice. Keep a note of which races you have already won; the tracker counter here is for your own tally.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Take on Cal's fishing challenge and beat him at it. Fishing is one of the 9 activity types, so the attempt also feeds Master of None. Watch Cal's rhythm rather than mashing: steady reeling beats frantic input, and a better rod — if the game offers upgrades — is worth having before the challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Find an arcade cabinet and finish one full arcade game. Any cabinet counts, so pick the shortest game on offer and play it to its end — a high score is not required, only completion. This also ticks one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Work through Andy's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. Character strands are separate from the main story, so check the map for Andy's marker between story chapters rather than waiting until after the credits. Finish the whole strand — only its final mission pops the trophy.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Work through Kenton's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. Kenton's strand is one of five character questlines with its own trophy, so keep returning to his marker between story chapters. Only the final mission pops the trophy.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Work through Billy's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. Billy's strand is one of five character questlines with its own trophy. Check for his marker between story chapters so the strand does not pile up at the end. Only the final mission pops the trophy.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full Strangers & Freaks mission strands across Leonida — whole strands, not single missions. Stranger markers appear as you explore, so sweep each region as the story opens it and finish strands when you find them instead of collecting half-finished ones. The five character questlines (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) are separate trophies; these 8 are the stranger strands on top of them.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Work through Randy's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. Randy's strand is one of five character questlines with its own trophy. Keep returning to his marker between story chapters. Only the final mission pops the trophy.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Work through Tyrone's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. Tyrone's strand is one of five character questlines with its own trophy. Keep returning to his marker between story chapters. Only the final mission pops the trophy.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida — the count is PSN's. This is the one trophy guides flag as potentially missable: the meditation event at Jason's house in Chapter 1 may not come back, so do it before leaving Chapter 1. After that, sweep the remaining spots region by region in free roam; each spot only needs one meditation.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Take Bret's hunting request and bring down the unique animal he names. Hunting is one of the activity types, so the outing also feeds Master of None. Track the animal rather than wandering: use the game's tracking cues, approach downwind and take the shot only when the animal is still.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida, so collect as you travel rather than hunting them all at the end — a set only counts when every card in it is found. Keep a checklist of which sets are finished; duplicates do not help. This silver is the collectible grind that most overlaps with the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK feature at 100 locations across Leonida. Fold this into exploration: scan every new landmark, shop and vista as you pass it, and the count climbs without a dedicated grind. The 100% checklist also asks for vehicle scans, so pair WAiNK stops with vehicle spotting on the same routes.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges from the game's challenge list (80 are available, and the 100% checklist asks for 70 of them, so this is a milestone on the way to a bigger number). Pick the short ones first — time trials, accuracy drills and simple feats — and leave the long grinds for the cleanup stage. Track your count here and in the game's own challenge menu.

sources.name: U7BUY — GTA 6 trophies guide (70 of 80 challenges)

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside, build a 4-star wanted level and then lose it completely — the escape is the point, not the crime. Pick a quiet stretch of road away from the city centre, cause enough trouble to reach 4 stars, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until the stars clear. Do not get caught or killed mid-escape, or the attempt resets.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level — the streak is what counts, so the wanted level must stay active across all three. Plan a route of three close-together shops, hit them fast, and keep moving between them; stopping to fight the police risks the run. If the wanted level drops, the chain breaks and you start over.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles across Leonida. Discovery is about variety, not ownership: drive past, scan or sit in as many distinct models as you can find — city traffic, docks, airfields and rural roads each hold different sets. The 100% checklist separately asks for 200 base-model vehicles scanned, so keep discovering past 100.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one single activation of Combat Focus. Set it up deliberately: find a spot with a cluster of enemies, trigger Combat Focus only when at least 5 are in range, and keep the chain going without letting it expire. If the focus ends at 4, reset and try again — the count must happen in one use.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave Vice City International Airport in an unscheduled way — that is, take off in an aircraft without following the airport's normal departure. Grab a plane on the apron, get it moving and get airborne before security stops you. Expect a wanted level; the escape is part of the fun, and the trophy pops on the departure itself.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description is a joke, not an instruction — this is the hidden trophy for taking control of a Rhino military tank and meeting its combat requirement, as trophy guides report. Steal or commandeer a Rhino, then use it in combat until the trophy pops. Bring it somewhere open where you can fight without being boxed in, and expect heavy police attention.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected at all — no alarm, no witness, no wanted level. Scout the store first: learn the camera and clerk positions, move quietly, take the goods and leave before anyone reacts. If you are spotted, leave and reset; a detected run does not count.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one — the escape counts, so a vault cracked but a getaway failed does not. Plan each job with a fast vehicle parked for the exit, hit the vault, and break away cleanly before the response closes in. Space the jobs out between other work; five clean escapes beat five rushed ones.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Stop an armored truck, rob it and escape. Ambush it on a quiet road rather than in traffic: block it, crack it open, take the cash and get clear before backup arrives. The escape is part of the requirement, so have a fast getaway vehicle ready before you start.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida — the count is PSN's. Drive, fly and walk through every named area until the map is filled in; the tracker counter here is for your own tally, the game's map is the authority. Pair this with vehicle discovery and WAiNK scans on the same routes so one trip feeds three trophies.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — one per gang, so the same gang twice does not help. Learn which operation belongs to which gang before hitting it, and tick gangs off in the tracker as you go so the last one is not a mystery. These robberies feed the 100% checklist's criminal activities too.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to Ocean Beach, find a spot with a view over the water, and enjoy a cocktail there. It is a quiet moment, not a challenge: buy or order a cocktail at a beachfront spot and let the scene play. No wanted level, no timer — just the view.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a vehicle out of a showroom by smashing through it, in classic style — the trophy is for the escape, not a purchase. Pick a showroom with a big glass front, get a sturdy car inside or at the door, and go straight through it. Expect a wanted level and a bill for the damage; the style is the point.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and complete the follow-through the trophy asks for — play a game of bowling there through to its end. Bowling is one of the 9 activity types, so it also feeds Master of None. Aim for a clean follow-through rather than a high score; finishing the game is what matters.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Raise both Jason's and Lucia's Strength attributes to maximum, as trophy guides report — the vague description hides a training grind for both leads. Work out regularly with each character and track the attribute in the stats menu; maxing one partner does not cover the other. It is a slow burn, so start early and train a little between missions.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile — PSN tracks the count to 500. There is no single trick: every choice that moves your criminal standing counts, so play the game the way the profile measures it — jobs, robberies, chases and choices that build the record — and the number climbs across the whole playthrough. Check the profile in the stats menu to see your tally.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Trigger the hidden second-chance event the description hints at. Honest warning: the exact method is still unverified in published guides — trophy sites list the trigger as under investigation. Do not chase it blindly; play normally, retry failed moments rather than reloading old saves, and check back as guides confirm the trigger. This entry will not invent a method it cannot cite.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Experience the mysterious hidden encounter the description hints at. Honest warning: the exact trigger is still unverified in published guides — trophy sites list it as a strange encounter whose conditions are not yet established. Explore Leonida's odd corners in free roam (remote spots, night-time, unusual landmarks) and let it find you; this entry will not invent a trigger it cannot cite.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by — a melee strike from a moving vehicle. The precise conditions are still under investigation in published guides, so the safe read is: from a slow-moving vehicle, land a melee hit on a target on foot. Keep speed low enough to aim, strike, and confirm the hit before driving on.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a total of $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists, so the laundering follows the crime work — keep a steady flow of bills moving through contacts across the playthrough rather than stockpiling them. The count is cumulative, so small launderings add up; the tracker counter here is for your own tally in dollars.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shops in the game. It is cumulative across every shop, so buy what you actually need — weapons, ammo, clothes, vehicle upgrades — and the total climbs on its own. If you reach the endgame short of the mark, top it up with big-ticket purchases you will use anyway, like vehicle mods.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties across Leonida. Garages are also where your vehicle collection lives, so buy them as you can afford them rather than all at the end — each one unlocks storage you will use. The money comes from the same heists and jobs that feed the other money trophies.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find 10 distinct vehicles you want to keep, open the Scooter Bros app and register each one — registration is the point, not ownership alone. Pair this with vehicle discovery: every new model you find is a candidate for the next slot.

roadmap.title: Story first
roadmap.text: Play Chapters 1–4 and the final mission in order. Keep a manual save before every story mission — the game has no mission replay. Do the Chapter 1 meditation at Jason's house before leaving Chapter 1. Earns 12 story trophies, including the gold final-mission trophy.

roadmap.title: Character strands
roadmap.text: Finish the five character questlines (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone), the 8 Strangers & Freaks strands and Bret's hunt between story chapters. Earns 7 trophies.

roadmap.title: Collectibles & exploration
roadmap.text: Sweep Leonida: 52 areas, 100 vehicles, 100 WAiNK scans, 3 card sets, 18 meditation spots, 10 Scooter Bros registrations, the Ocean Beach cocktail. Earns 7 trophies.

roadmap.title: Activities & crime
roadmap.text: 42 shooting-range golds, 250 stunts, 20 races, 14 drone-race wins, 50 challenges, the robbery set (5 vaults, 9 gangs, armored truck, jewelry store) and the wanted-level escapes. Earns 20 trophies.

roadmap.title: Cleanup & 100%
roadmap.text: Finish the money and profile grinds ($250,000 laundered, $100,000 spent, 8 garages, 500 profile actions, max Strength for both leads), the two unverified hidden encounters, then the 100% checklist for A Long Road — and the platinum. Earns 9 trophies.

notes.missable_rule: A trophy is flagged missable when the official description ties it to a story chapter or mission in a game with no mission replay, or when published guides flag its moment as one-time (the Chapter 1 meditation). 13 trophies are flagged: the 12 story-progression trophies (ids 2–13) plus Positive Mental Attitude (id 28).
notes.hidden_rule: Hidden flags follow the official list as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles: 28 hidden, 27 shown.
notes.online: No trophy in the official list needs online play; the list is single-player only.
notes.sources_note: Every guide above is this entry's own words. Names, descriptions, grades, hidden flags and PSN counts come from the official list as Exophase and PSNProfiles published it; where a guide uses a fact beyond the description (a count, a trigger, the no-replay rule), the trophy's sources name the guide it came from.
